same_explanation_quote: No change on the document's list separates the two; the paper offers no comparison. At this level they are the same explanation.
layer_at_fault_line: No finding in this report is contradicted by file 33's wording as read here, and the document itself (I2) was not before the marker to check against; nothing to fault.
